SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".id) AS "count" FROM "cards" AS "c" INNER JOIN "sets" AS "s" ON "c".setcode = "s".code INNER JOIN "foreign_data" AS "f" ON "f".uuid = "c".uuid WHERE "s".name = 'Coldsnap' AND "f".language = 'Italian' AND "f".text IS NOT NULL AND "f".text <> '' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "qualified".userid) AS "user_count" FROM (SELECT "organizer".userid, "organizer".id FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN "badges" AS "organizer" ON "organizer".userid = "u".id AND "organizer".name = 'Organizer' INNER JOIN "badges" AS "prior" ON "prior".userid = "u".id AND "prior".date < "organizer".date WHERE "u".location ILIKE '%Germany%' GROUP BY "organizer".userid, "organizer".id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5) AS "qualified" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "user_count" FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN (SELECT owneruserid, MIN(creaiondate) AS "first_post_date" FROM "posts" WHERE owneruserid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY owneruserid) AS "p" ON "p".owneruserid = "u".id WHERE "p".first_post_date >= '2010-01-01' AND "p".first_post_date < '2011-01-01' AND (TRIM("u".location) ILIKE 'India' OR TRIM("u".location) ILIKE '%, India' OR TRIM("u".location) ILIKE '%,India') LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "u".location ILIKE '%Germany%' THEN "p".score ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "germany_editor_total_score", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "u".location ILIKE '%Germany%' THEN 0 ELSE "p".score END), 0) AS "other_posts_total_score", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "u".location ILIKE '%Germany%' THEN "u".id END) AS "germany_editor_count", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM("g".reputation), 0) FROM "users" AS "g" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT lasteditoruserid FROM "posts" WHERE creaiondate >= '2012-01-01' AND creaiondate < '2013-01-01') AS "e" ON "e".lasteditoruserid = "g".id WHERE "g".location ILIKE '%Germany%') AS "germany_editors_combined_reputation" FROM "posts" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".lasteditoruserid WHERE "p".creaiondate >= '2012-01-01' AND "p".creaiondate < '2013-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM("u".reputation), 0) AS "combined_reputation" FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT owneruserid FROM "posts" WHERE score = 10 AND tags LIKE '%<r>%') AS "p" ON "p".owneruserid = "u".id LIMIT 501

AS "linked" ON "linked".postid = "p".id WHERE "p".posttypeid = 1 AND "p".tags LIKE '%<r>%' LIMIT 501

SELECT age FROM "users" WHERE location IN ('York', 'York, United Kingdom') AND reputation = (SELECT MAX(reputation) FROM "users" WHERE location IN ('York', 'York, United Kingdom')) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("u".upvotes::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_upvotes_cast", ROUND(AVG("u".age::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_age" FROM "users" AS "u" INNER JOIN (SELECT owneruserid FROM "posts" WHERE creaiondate >= '2012-01-01' AND creaiondate < '2013-01-01' GROUP BY owneruserid HAVING COUNT(*) > 10) AS "active" ON "active".owneruserid = "u".id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "u".reputation < 1000 OR "u".id IS NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "posts" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "users" AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".owneruserid WHERE "p".creaiondate >= '2010-01-01' AND "p".creaiondate < '2011-01-01' AND "p".score > 5 LIMIT 501

AND "ph".comment IS NOT NULL AND "ph".comment <> '' GROUP BY "ph".userid, COALESCE("u".displayname, "ph".userdisplayname) HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "posthistory" AS "ph2" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "ph2".postid WHERE "p2".title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?' AND "ph2".comment IS NOT NULL AND "ph2".comment <> '' GROUP BY "ph2".userid, "ph2".userdisplayname ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'SME' THEN total END) - MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'LAM' THEN total END))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "sme_minus_lam", ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'LAM' THEN total END) - MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'KAM' THEN total END))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "lam_minus_kam", ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'KAM' THEN total END) - MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'SME' THEN total END))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "kam_minus_sme" FROM (SELECT segment, total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY total ASC, customerid ASC) AS "rn" FROM (SELECT "c".segment, "c".customerid, SUM("y".consumption::NUMERIC) AS "total" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'CZK' AND "c".segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND "y".date >= '201301' AND "y".date < '201401' GROUP BY "c".segment, "c".customerid) AS "totals") AS "ranked" WHERE rn = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT segment, ROUND(increase_percentage::NUMERIC, 2) AS "increase_percentage" FROM (SELECT segment, increase_percentage, MAX(increase_percentage) OVER () AS "highest", MIN(increase_percentage) OVER () AS "lowest" FROM (SELECT "c".segment, 100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN "y".date >= '201301' AND "y".date < '201401' THEN "y".consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN "y".date >= '201201' AND "y".date < '201301' THEN "y".consumption ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "y".date >= '201201' AND "y".date < '201301' THEN "y".consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "increase_percentage" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'EUR' AND "c".segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND "y".date >= '201201' AND "y".date < '201401' GROUP BY "c".segment) AS "changes") AS "extremes" WHERE increase_percentage = highest OR increase_percentage = lowest ORDER BY increase_percentage DESC, segment ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(((SUM(CASE WHEN "y".date >= '201301' AND "y".date < '201401' THEN "y".consumption::NUMERIC END) - SUM(CASE WHEN "y".date >= '201201' AND "y".date < '201301' THEN "y".consumption::NUMERIC END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "y".date >= '201201' AND "y".date < '201301' THEN "y".consumption::NUMERIC END), 0)), 4) AS "relative_change" FROM "yearmonth" AS "y" WHERE "y".customerid IN (SELECT "t".customerid FROM "transactions_1k" AS "t" WHERE "t".date = DATE '2012-08-25' AND "t".price::NUMERIC = 634.8) GROUP BY "y".customerid LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".segment, COUNT(*) AS "customer_count" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN (SELECT customerid FROM "yearmonth" WHERE date >= '201201' AND date < '201301' GROUP BY customerid HAVING SUM(consumption) < 30000) AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid GROUP BY "c".segment ORDER BY "c".segment ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT currency, ROUND(AVG(quarterly_consumption)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_quarterly_consumption" FROM (SELECT "c".customerid, "c".currency, SUM("y".consumption) AS "quarterly_consumption" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "y".date >= '201304' AND "y".date < '201307' AND "c".currency IN ('EUR', 'CZK') GROUP BY "c".customerid, "c".currency) AS "quarterly" GROUP BY currency ORDER BY CASE WHEN currency = 'EUR' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND((AVG(annual_consumption) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'CZK') - AVG(annual_consumption) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'EUR'))::NUMERIC) AS "difference" FROM (SELECT "c".customerid, "c".currency, SUM("y".consumption::NUMERIC) AS "annual_consumption" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "y".date >= '201201' AND "y".date < '201301' AND "y".consumption IS NOT NULL AND "c".currency IN ('CZK', 'EUR') GROUP BY "c".customerid, "c".currency) AS "customer_consumption" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "customer_count" FROM (SELECT "y".customerid FROM "yearmonth" AS "y" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "y".customerid WHERE "c".segment = 'KAM' AND "c".currency = 'CZK' AND "y".date >= '201301' AND "y".date < '201401' GROUP BY "y".customerid HAVING SUM("y".consumption) > 1000000) AS "qualifying_customers" LIMIT 501

SELECT "t".team_long_name FROM "match" AS "m" INNER JOIN "league" AS "l" ON "l".id = "m".league_id INNER JOIN "team" AS "t" ON "t".team_api_id = "m".away_team_api_id WHERE "l".name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND "m".season = '2009/2010' AND "m".away_team_goal > "m".home_team_goal GROUP BY "t".team_api_id, "t".team_long_name HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX("wins".win_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "win_count" FROM "match" AS "m2" INNER JOIN "league" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "m2".league_id WHERE "l2".name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND "m2".season = '2009/2010' AND "m2".away_team_goal > "m2".home_team_goal GROUP BY "m2".away_team_api_id) AS "wins") LIMIT 501

SELECT "t".team_long_name FROM "team" AS "t" INNER JOIN "team_attributes" AS "ta" ON "ta".team_api_id = "t".team_api_id WHERE "ta".date >= '2012-01-01' AND "ta".date < '2013-01-01' AND "ta".buildupplaypassing > (SELECT AVG("ta2".buildupplaypassing) FROM "team_attributes" AS "ta2" WHERE "ta2".date >= '2012-01-01' AND "ta2".date < '2013-01-01') LIMIT 501

SELECT "l".name FROM "league" AS "l" INNER JOIN "match" AS "m" ON "m".league_id = "l".id WHERE "m".season = '2009/2010' GROUP BY "l".id, "l".name HAVING AVG("m".home_team_goal) > AVG("m".away_team_goal) LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".player_name FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN "player_attributes" AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM "player") OR "p".height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM "player") GROUP BY "p".id, "p".player_name ORDER BY AVG("pa".finishing) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(("ariel".overall_rating - "paulin".overall_rating)::NUMERIC * 100 / NULLIF("paulin".overall_rating, 0), 2) AS "percentage_higher" FROM (SELECT "pa".overall_rating FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN "player_attributes" AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk' ORDER BY "pa".date DESC NULLS LAST, "pa".id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "ariel" CROSS JOIN (SELECT "pa".overall_rating FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN "player_attributes" AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".player_name = 'Paulin Puel' ORDER BY "pa".date DESC NULLS LAST, "pa".id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "paulin" LIMIT 501

SELECT "pa".date FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN "player_attributes" AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".player_name = 'Kevin Constant' AND "pa".crossing = (SELECT MAX("pa2".crossing) FROM "player_attributes" AS "pa2" WHERE "pa2".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id) ORDER BY "pa".date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "pa".overall_rating > 70 THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "player" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "player_attributes" AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".height < 180 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rated_high = 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM (SELECT "p".id, MAX(CASE WHEN "a".defensive_work_rate = 'high' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "rated_high" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN "player_attributes" AS "a" ON "a".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".birthday >= '1991-01-01' AND "a".defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high') GROUP BY "p".id) AS "ratings" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("p".height)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (player_api_id) player_api_id, defensive_work_rate FROM "player_attributes" ORDER BY player_api_id ASC, date DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC) AS "a" ON "a".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "a".defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'high') LIMIT 501

SELECT "t".team_short_name, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_clubs", ROUND(AVG("a".chancecreationpassing), 1) AS "average_chance_creation_passing_risk" FROM "team" AS "t" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT team_api_id FROM "team_attributes" WHERE chancecreationpassingclass = 'Risky') AS "r" ON "r".team_api_id = "t".team_api_id LEFT JOIN "team_attributes" AS "a" ON "a".id = (SELECT "a2".id FROM "team_attributes" AS "a2" WHERE "a2".team_api_id = "t".team_api_id AND "a2".date < '2014-09-20' ORDER BY "a2".date DESC, "a2".id DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY "t".team_short_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY average_chance_creation_passing_risk DESC NULLS LAST, "t".team_short_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("p".height)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (player_api_id) player_api_id, defensive_work_rate FROM "player_attributes" WHERE defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high') ORDER BY player_api_id ASC, date DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC) AS "a" ON "a".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".birthday >= '1990-01-01' AND "p".birthday < '1996-01-01' AND "a".defensive_work_rate = 'medium' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("p".weight), 1) AS "average_weight" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id FROM "player_attributes" WHERE preferred_foot = 'left') AS "pa" ON "pa".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".player_name, COUNT("m".id) AS "matches_played" FROM "player" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "match" AS "m" ON "m".season = '2015/2016' AND "p".player_api_id IN ("m".home_player_1, "m".home_player_2, "m".home_player_3, "m".home_player_4, "m".home_player_5, "m".home_player_6, "m".home_player_7, "m".home_player_8, "m".home_player_9, "m".home_player_10, "m".home_player_11, "m".away_player_1, "m".away_player_2, "m".away_player_3, "m".away_player_4, "m".away_player_5, "m".away_player_6, "m".away_player_7, "m".away_player_8, "m".away_player_9, "m".away_player_10, "m".away_player_11) WHERE "p".player_name LIKE 'Adam%' AND "p".weight > 170 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".player_name LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "ta".buildupplaydribblingclass FROM "team_attributes" AS "ta" INNER JOIN "team" AS "t" ON "t".team_api_id = "ta".team_api_id INNER JOIN "match" AS "m" ON "m".home_team_api_id = "t".team_api_id OR "m".away_team_api_id = "t".team_api_id INNER JOIN "country" AS "c" ON "c".id = "m".country_id WHERE "t".team_short_name = 'POR' AND "c".name = 'England' AND "ta".date >= '2015-09-10' AND "ta".date < '2015-09-11' LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".season, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".player_api_id) AS "number_of_players" FROM "match" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id IN ("m".away_player_1, "m".away_player_2, "m".away_player_3, "m".away_player_4, "m".away_player_5, "m".away_player_6, "m".away_player_7, "m".away_player_8, "m".away_player_9, "m".away_player_10, "m".away_player_11) WHERE "m".home_team_goal - "m".away_team_goal >= 5 GROUP BY "m".season ORDER BY "m".season ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".season, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".player_api_id) AS "player_count", ROUND(AVG("p".height)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_height_cm" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "m".season, "p".player_api_id, "p".height FROM "match" AS "m" INNER JOIN "country" AS "c" ON "c".id = "m".country_id INNER JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id IN ("m".home_player_1, "m".home_player_2, "m".home_player_3, "m".home_player_4, "m".home_player_5, "m".home_player_6, "m".home_player_7, "m".home_player_8, "m".home_player_9, "m".home_player_10, "m".home_player_11, "m".away_player_1, "m".away_player_2, "m".away_player_3, "m".away_player_4, "m".away_player_5, "m".away_player_6, "m".away_player_7, "m".away_player_8, "m".away_player_9, "m".away_player_10, "m".away_player_11) WHERE "c".name = 'Italy' AND "m".season IN ('2008/2009', '2015/2016')) AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT season FROM "match" WHERE season IN ('2008/2009', '2015/2016')) AS "m" ON "m".season = "p".season GROUP BY "m".season ORDER BY "m".season ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "player_count" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (player_api_id) player_api_id, volleys FROM "player_attributes" ORDER BY player_api_id ASC, date DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC) AS "a" ON "a".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "p".height > 180 AND "a".volleys > 70 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("t".total_goals, 0)), 2) AS "average_total_home_goals" FROM "player" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT home_player_3, SUM(home_team_goal) AS "total_goals" FROM "match" WHERE home_player_3 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY home_player_3) AS "t" ON "t".home_player_3 = "p".player_api_id LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".name FROM "country" AS "c" INNER JOIN "match" AS "m" ON "m".country_id = "c".id INNER JOIN "player" AS "p" ON "p".player_api_id IN ("m".home_player_1, "m".home_player_2, "m".home_player_3, "m".home_player_4, "m".home_player_5, "m".home_player_6, "m".home_player_7, "m".home_player_8, "m".home_player_9, "m".home_player_10, "m".home_player_11, "m".away_player_1, "m".away_player_2, "m".away_player_3, "m".away_player_4, "m".away_player_5, "m".away_player_6, "m".away_player_7, "m".away_player_8, "m".away_player_9, "m".away_player_10, "m".away_player_11) WHERE "p".weight <= 160 GROUP BY "c".id, "c".name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "p".player_api_id) = (SELECT MIN(country_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p2".player_api_id) AS "country_count" FROM "country" AS "c2" INNER JOIN "match" AS "m2" ON "m2".country_id = "c2".id LEFT JOIN "player" AS "p2" ON "p2".weight <= 160 AND "p2".player_api_id IN ("m2".home_player_1, "m2".home_player_2, "m2".home_player_3, "m2".home_player_4, "m2".home_player_5, "m2".home_player_6, "m2".home_player_7, "m2".home_player_8, "m2".home_player_9, "m2".home_player_10, "m2".home_player_11, "m2".away_player_1, "m2".away_player_2, "m2".away_player_3, "m2".away_player_4, "m2".away_player_5, "m2".away_player_6, "m2".away_player_7, "m2".away_player_8, "m2".away_player_9, "m2".away_player_10, "m2".away_player_11) GROUP BY "c2".id) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "player_count" FROM "player" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (player_api_id) player_api_id, preferred_foot, attacking_work_rate FROM "player_attributes" WHERE date::TIMESTAMP < TIMESTAMP '2015-01-02 00:00:00' ORDER BY player_api_id ASC, date DESC, id DESC) AS "a" ON "a".player_api_id = "p".player_api_id WHERE "a".preferred_foot = 'left' AND "a".attacking_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "current_attributes".attacking_work_rate = 'low') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("pa".player_api_id) "pa".player_api_id, "pa".preferred_foot, "pa".attacking_work_rate FROM "player_attributes" AS "pa" ORDER BY "pa".player_api_id ASC, "pa".date DESC NULLS LAST, "pa".id DESC) AS "current_attributes" WHERE "current_attributes".preferred_foot = 'left' AND "current_attributes".attacking_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high') LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "disp".account_id, (SELECT MAX(a11) - MIN(a11) FROM "district") AS "salary_difference" FROM "client" INNER JOIN "district" ON "client".district_id = "district".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" ON "disp".client_id = "client".client_id WHERE "client".gender = 'F' AND "district".a11 = (SELECT MIN(a11) FROM "district") AND "client".birth_date = (SELECT MIN("c".birth_date) FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "c".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "d".a11 = (SELECT MIN(a11) FROM "district")) LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "district".a2 AS "district" FROM "client" INNER JOIN "disp" ON "disp".client_id = "client".client_id INNER JOIN "account" ON "account".account_id = "disp".account_id INNER JOIN "district" ON "district".district_id = "account".district_id WHERE "client".gender = 'F' AND "client".birth_date = DATE '1976-01-29' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".gender = 'M') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "male_percentage" FROM "client" AS "c" WHERE "c".district_id = (SELECT "d".district_id FROM "district" AS "d" WHERE "d".a3 = 'south Bohemia' ORDER BY CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) DESC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".frequency, "o".k_symbol FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "order" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".account_id = 3 AND "o".amount = 3539 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".a2 AS "district", CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) AS "population" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "a".date >= (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN("f".date)) FROM "account" AS "f") AND "a".date < (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN("f".date)) + INTERVAL '1 month' FROM "account" AS "f") AND CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) = (SELECT MAX(CAST("d2".a4 AS BIGINT)) FROM "district" AS "d2" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a2" ON "a2".district_id = "d2".district_id WHERE "a2".date >= (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN("f2".date)) FROM "account" AS "f2") AND "a2".date < (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN("f2".date)) + INTERVAL '1 month' FROM "account" AS "f2")) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "t".trans_id) AS "transaction_count" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE ("t".k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM("t".k_symbol) = '') AND "d".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".gender = 'M' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1974-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1977-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", ROUND(COALESCE(SUM("l".amount), 0)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id), 0)) AS "average_active_loan_per_account" FROM (SELECT district_id, a2 FROM "district" ORDER BY CAST(a4 AS BIGINT) DESC LIMIT 5) AS "d" LEFT JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2 ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM("l".amount), 0)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id), 0) DESC NULLS LAST, "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT region, total_amount FROM (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", SUM("l".amount) AS "total_amount", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM("l".amount) DESC) AS "position" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".date + "l".duration * INTERVAL '1 month' > DATE '1995-12-31' GROUP BY "d".a3) AS "ranked" WHERE position = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Bohemia' AND "a".date < DATE '1996-01-01' AND "t".bank = 'AB' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary", COUNT(*) AS "district_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "a".district_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "p" ON "p".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "p".client_id WHERE "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1990-01-01') AS "served" ON "served".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'east Bohemia' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "c".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".client_id = "c".client_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "account_disp".account_id FROM "disp" AS "account_disp" INNER JOIN "card" AS "card" ON "card".disp_id = "account_disp".disp_id) AS "card_accounts" ON "card_accounts".account_id = "owner_disp".account_id WHERE "card_accounts".account_id IS NULL) AS "eligible_districts" ON "eligible_districts".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("l".loan_count, 0)), 2) AS "average_loans_per_account" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "a".account_id AND "d".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "c".birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS "household_payments", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol <> 'SIPO' AND TRIM("t".k_symbol) <> '') AS "other_purpose_payments" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'M' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1974-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1977-01-01') AS "cohort" ON "cohort".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".amount > 4000 AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id AS "account_number", "a".date AS "account_opening_date", "l".total_borrowed, COALESCE("t".counterparties, 0) AS "outside_bank_counterparties", "home".a2 AS "owner_home_district", "home".a4::BIGINT AS "district_population", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "home".a4::BIGINT DESC NULLS LAST) AS "population_rank" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "branch" ON "branch".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS "total_borrowed" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "a".account_id AND "d".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "home" ON "home".district_id = "c".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT account) AS "counterparties" FROM "trans" WHERE operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND bank IS NOT NULL GROUP BY account_id) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "branch".a2 = 'Prachatice' ORDER BY "home".a4::BIGINT DESC NULLS LAST, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "x".gender, "x".district_count, "x".district, "x".inhabitants, "x".average_salary, "x".average_urban_ratio FROM (SELECT "q".gender, "q".district, "q".inhabitants, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "q".gender) AS "district_count", ROUND(AVG("q".salary) OVER (PARTITION BY "q".gender), 2) AS "average_salary", ROUND(AVG("q".urban_ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY "q".gender), 2) AS "average_urban_ratio", MAX("q".inhabitants) OVER (PARTITION BY "q".gender) AS "max_inhabitants" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "c".gender, "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district", CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) AS "inhabitants", CAST("d".a11 AS NUMERIC) AS "salary", CAST("d".a10 AS NUMERIC) AS "urban_ratio" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "cd" ON "cd".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "cd".account_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "od" ON "od".account_id = "a".account_id AND "od".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "od".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "ca".type = 'gold' AND CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) > 100000 AND "a".account_id IN (SELECT "t".account_id FROM "trans" AS "t" GROUP BY "t".account_id HAVING AVG("t".balance) > 1000)) AS "q") AS "x" WHERE "x".inhabitants = "x".max_inhabitants ORDER BY CASE WHEN "x".gender = 'F' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, "x".district ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT recipient_bank_code, recipient_counter_account, number_of_outgoing_payments, total_amount_paid FROM (SELECT "t".bank AS "recipient_bank_code", "t".account AS "recipient_counter_account", COUNT(*) AS "number_of_outgoing_payments", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_paid", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM("t".amount) DESC) AS "payment_rank" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "di".account_id FROM "disp" AS "di" INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "di".disp_id WHERE "di".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".type = 'gold') AS "gold_accounts" ON "gold_accounts".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "t".date >= '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < '1999-01-01' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".bank <> '' AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) >= 250000 GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account) AS "ranked" WHERE payment_rank = 1 ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM("t".amount), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".a2 = 'Pisek' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND NULLIF(TRIM("t".k_symbol), '') IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "x".region, ROUND(AVG("x".salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_district_salary", ROUND(AVG("x".unemployment)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_1996_district_unemployment_rate", MAX(CASE WHEN "x".district_rank = 1 THEN "x".district_name END) AS "most_populous_district" FROM (SELECT "q".region, "q".salary, "q".unemployment, "q".district_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "q".region ORDER BY "q".population DESC, "q".district_name ASC) AS "district_rank" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "d".district_id, "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a11 AS "salary", "d".a12 AS "unemployment", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "population" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "p" ON "p".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "p".disp_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "p".account_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "p".type = 'OWNER') AS "q") AS "x" GROUP BY "x".region ORDER BY "x".region ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a15 AS "crimes_1996", ROUND(AVG("d".a15) OVER (), 2) AS "three_district_average", ROUND((SELECT AVG(a15) FROM "district"), 2) AS "overall_average", ROUND(AVG("d".a15) OVER () - (SELECT AVG(a15) FROM "district"), 2) AS "difference" FROM (SELECT a2, a15, a4 FROM "district" WHERE a3 = 'central Bohemia' ORDER BY CAST(a4 AS BIGINT) DESC NULLS LAST, translate(lower(a2), 'áäčďéěíľĺňóôöřŕšťúůüýž', 'aacdeeillnooorrstuuuyz') ASC, a2 ASC LIMIT 3) AS "d" ORDER BY CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) DESC NULLS LAST, translate(lower("d".a2), 'áäčďéěíľĺňóôöřŕšťúůüýž', 'aacdeeillnooorrstuuuyz') ASC, "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "c".type AS "card_type", "d".a2 AS "home_district", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants" FROM "card" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "c".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl".client_id = "dp".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "cl".district_id WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT = (SELECT MIN("d2".a4::BIGINT) FROM "card" AS "c2" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp2" ON "dp2".disp_id = "c2".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl2" ON "cl2".client_id = "dp2".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d2" ON "d2".district_id = "cl2".district_id WHERE "c2".type = "c".type) ORDER BY "c".type ASC, "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".district_name, "s".accounts_opened, ROUND("s".district_average, 2) AS "average_end_of_1996_balance", ROUND(SUM("s".balance_sum) OVER () / NULLIF(SUM("s".balance_count) OVER (), 0), 2) AS "region_wide_average_end_of_1996_balance", FIRST_VALUE("s".district_name) OVER (ORDER BY "s".district_average DESC NULLS LAST, "s".district_name ASC) AS "district_with_highest_average_end_of_1996_balance" FROM (SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened", AVG("t".balance) AS "district_average", SUM("t".balance) AS "balance_sum", COUNT("t".balance) AS "balance_count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".trans_id = (SELECT "t2".trans_id FROM "trans" AS "t2" WHERE "t2".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t2".date < DATE '1997-01-01' ORDER BY "t2".date DESC, "t2".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01' AND "d".a3 = (SELECT a3 FROM "district" WHERE a2 = 'Litomerice') GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2) AS "s" ORDER BY "s".district_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", ROUND((SELECT AVG("ds".a11)::NUMERIC FROM "district" AS "ds" WHERE "ds".district_id IN (SELECT "a".district_id FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".loan_id ASC LIMIT 10)), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" WHERE "d".district_id IN (SELECT "a".district_id FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".loan_id ASC LIMIT 10) ORDER BY "d".a4::BIGINT DESC NULLS LAST, "d".district_id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "population", "w".total_withdrawn, ROUND("w".total_withdrawn::NUMERIC / "d".a4::BIGINT, 2) AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "w".total_withdrawn::NUMERIC / "d".a4::BIGINT DESC) AS "district_rank", ROUND("o".total_order_debits / "o".account_count, 2) AS "average_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT "a".district_id, SUM("t".amount) AS "total_withdrawn" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY "a".district_id) AS "w" ON "w".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN (SELECT "a".district_id, COUNT(*) AS "account_count", SUM(COALESCE("s".order_debits, 0)) AS "total_order_debits" FROM "account" AS "a" LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount::NUMERIC) AS "order_debits" FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id) AS "s" ON "s".account_id = "a".account_id GROUP BY "a".district_id) AS "o" ON "o".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 100000 ORDER BY district_rank ASC, "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opened_date", "a".frequency, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", CASE WHEN "a".district_id = "c".district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "is_home_district", "d".a11 AS "average_salary", COALESCE("l".status, 'none') AS "loan_repayment_status", COALESCE("l".amount, 0) AS "loan_amount", COALESCE("t".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("t".total_income, 0) AS "total_income", COALESCE("t".total_expense, 0) AS "total_expense", COALESCE("t".total_income, 0) - COALESCE("t".total_expense, 0) AS "net_balance", "r".client_count AS "region_client_count", "p".a2 AS "most_populous_district", "p".a4 AS "most_populous_district_inhabitants", "d".population_rank AS "account_district_population_rank" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "di" ON "di".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "di".account_id INNER JOIN (SELECT district_id, a2, a3, a11, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY CAST(a4 AS BIGINT) DESC NULLS LAST) AS "population_rank" FROM "district") AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_income", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_expense" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN (SELECT "d2".a3, COUNT("c2".client_id) AS "client_count" FROM "district" AS "d2" LEFT JOIN "client" AS "c2" ON "c2".district_id = "d2".district_id GROUP BY "d2".a3) AS "r" ON "r".a3 = "d".a3 INNER JOIN (SELECT a3, a2, CAST(a4 AS BIGINT) AS "a4", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY CAST(a4 AS BIGINT) DESC NULLS LAST, district_id ASC) AS "rn" FROM "district") AS "p" ON "p".a3 = "d".a3 AND "p".rn = 1 WHERE "c".client_id = 3541 ORDER BY COALESCE("t".transaction_count, 0) DESC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT year, SUM(account_count) AS "accounts_opened", SUM(amount_lent) AS "total_amount_lent", ROUND(AVG(amount_lent / account_count), 2) AS "average_district_amount_lent_per_account" FROM (SELECT TO_CHAR("a".date, 'YYYY') AS "year", "a".district_id, COUNT(*) AS "account_count", SUM(COALESCE("l".amount_lent, 0)) AS "amount_lent" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS "amount_lent" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY TO_CHAR("a".date, 'YYYY'), "a".district_id) AS "district_year" GROUP BY year ORDER BY year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "l".amount AS "approved_amount", "l".date AS "approval_date", (SELECT "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "l".account_id AND "t".date <= "l".date ORDER BY "t".date DESC, "t".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "account_balance" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".date ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT "c".client_id, "c".gender, "c".birth_date, "ca".type AS "card_type", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) AS "age_at_card_issue", COALESCE("l".loan_count, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("l".total_borrowed, 0) AS "total_amount_borrowed", CASE WHEN COALESCE("l".loan_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'Non-borrower' WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) < 30 THEN 'Young borrower' ELSE 'Mature borrower' END AS "borrower_classification", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a11 AS "district_average_salary", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "c".gender ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) DESC) AS "age_rank_within_gender" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "di" ON "di".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "di".client_id LEFT JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count", SUM(amount) AS "total_borrowed" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "di".account_id WHERE "ca".issued >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "ca".issued < DATE '1995-01-01' ORDER BY "c".client_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "branch_name", COUNT("t".trans_id) AS "transaction_count" FROM "district" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".date < DATE '1998-10-15' AND ("t".k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM("t".k_symbol) = '') WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Moravia' GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "t".bank AS "bank_code", "t".account AS "account_number", COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payments", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "l".amount = 98832 AND "l".date = DATE '1996-01-03' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".date < DATE '1996-01-03' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".district_id = 1 AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'UROK' THEN "t".amount WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SANKC. UROK' THEN -"t".amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "net_interest_czk" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM "disp" WHERE client_id = 2823) AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".k_symbol IN ('UROK', 'SANKC. UROK') LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".client_id, ROUND("l".amount::NUMERIC, 2) AS "loan_amount", "l".duration AS "duration_months", ROUND("l".payments::NUMERIC * "l".duration, 2) AS "total_payments", ROUND("l".payments::NUMERIC * "l".duration - "l".amount, 2) AS "interest_paid", "l".status AS "loan_status", "d".a2 AS "district", "d".a3 AS "region", COALESCE("t".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", ROUND(COALESCE("t".total_deposits, 0)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_deposits", CASE WHEN COALESCE("t".total_deposits, 0) > 2 * "l".amount::NUMERIC THEN 'High Income' WHEN COALESCE("t".total_deposits, 0) > "l".amount THEN 'Medium Income' ELSE 'Low Income' END AS "income_category", "r".loan_count AS "loans_in_region", "s".average_salary AS "region_average_salary", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "c".birth_date))::INTEGER AS "completed_age" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id INNER JOIN (SELECT "l2".loan_id, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "l2".amount DESC) AS "loan_rank" FROM "loan" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp2" ON "dp2".account_id = "l2".account_id AND "dp2".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c2" ON "c2".client_id = "dp2".client_id WHERE "c2".gender = 'F') AS "ranked" ON "ranked".loan_id = "l".loan_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_deposits" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN (SELECT "d2".a3 AS "region", COUNT(*) AS "loan_count" FROM "loan" AS "l3" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a2" ON "a2".account_id = "l3".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d2" ON "d2".district_id = "a2".district_id GROUP BY "d2".a3) AS "r" ON "r".region = "d".a3 INNER JOIN (SELECT a3 AS "region", ROUND(AVG(a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "district" GROUP BY a3) AS "s" ON "s".region = "d".a3 WHERE "ranked".loan_rank <= 3 ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".loan_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", COUNT(DISTINCT "d".district_id) AS "district_count", SUM("d".a4::BIGINT) AS "combined_population", SUM("q".account_count) AS "account_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT "a".district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) AS "account_count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01' AND "l".duration > 24 GROUP BY "a".district_id) AS "q" ON "q".district_id = "d".district_id GROUP BY "d".a3 ORDER BY combined_population DESC, region ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(SUM("q".account_count), 0) AS "total_monthly_statement_accounts", COUNT(*) AS "districts_involved", ROUND(AVG("q".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary" FROM (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a11, COUNT(*) AS "account_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 100000 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND "a".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a11) AS "q" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", COALESCE("t".total_received, 0) AS "total_received", COALESCE("t".total_withdrawn, 0) AS "total_withdrawn", COALESCE("l".number_of_loans, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("t".external_counterparties, 0) AS "external_counterparties", DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("t".external_counterparties, 0) DESC) AS "rank" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "di".account_id FROM "disp" AS "di" INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "di".disp_id WHERE "c".type = 'gold') AS "g" ON "g".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_received", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_withdrawn", COUNT(DISTINCT (bank, account)) FILTER (WHERE bank IS NOT NULL AND bank <> '' AND account IS NOT NULL AND operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU')) AS "external_counterparties" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_loans" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id ORDER BY rank ASC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "date_opened", "c".gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '1996-12-31', "c".birth_date)) AS "age", COALESCE("cards".card_count, 0) AS "card_count", COALESCE("loans".loan_count, 0) AS "loan_count", CASE WHEN "loans".loan_count IS NULL THEN 'no loan' WHEN "loans".has_default THEN 'defaulted' WHEN "loans".has_repaying THEN 'repaying' ELSE 'paid off' END AS "loan_standing", COALESCE("t".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("t".money_in, 0) AS "money_in", COALESCE("t".money_out, 0) AS "money_out", COALESCE("t".peak_balance, 0) AS "peak_balance", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("t".peak_balance, 0) DESC) AS "balance_rank" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "owner_disp".client_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "dp".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "card_count" FROM "disp" AS "dp" INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "dp".disp_id WHERE "ca".issued < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY "dp".account_id) AS "cards" ON "cards".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count", BOOL_OR(status = 'B') AS "has_default", BOOL_OR(status IN ('C', 'D')) AS "has_repaying" FROM "loan" WHERE date < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY account_id) AS "loans" ON "loans".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "money_in", SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "money_out", MAX(balance) AS "peak_balance" FROM "trans" WHERE date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY account_id) AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a2 = 'Tabor' AND "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01' ORDER BY balance_rank ASC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", COUNT(DISTINCT "o".client_id) AS "client_count", COUNT(DISTINCT ("t".bank, "t".account)) FILTER (WHERE "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL) AS "external_account_count", COALESCE(SUM("t".amount), 0) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "district" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "disp".disp_id, "disp".client_id, "disp".account_id FROM "disp" INNER JOIN "card" ON "card".disp_id = "disp".disp_id WHERE "disp".type = 'OWNER' AND "card".type = 'classic') AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "o".disp_id IS NOT NULL AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2 ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC, "d".a2 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("x".a11), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "d".district_id, "d".a11 FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "p" ON "p".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "p".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1930-01-01') AS "x" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("d".a11), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT district_id FROM "client" WHERE gender = 'F' AND birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01') AS "c" ON "c".district_id = "d".district_id LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref, "d".nationality, "d".dob, "q".q1 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "r".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q1 <> '' AND "q".q1 = (SELECT MAX("q2".q1) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q1 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "q".q1 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "r".name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$' AND split_part("q".q1, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC = (SELECT MIN(split_part("q2".q1, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q2".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "q".raceid AND "q2".q1 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref, "d".nationality, "d".dob FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND NULLIF(TRIM("q".q2), '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM("q".q3), '') IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' AND "q".q2::INTERVAL = (SELECT MIN("q2".q2::INTERVAL) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q2 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' AND "q2".q2::INTERVAL > (SELECT MIN("q3".q2::INTERVAL) FROM "qualifying" AS "q3" WHERE "q3".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q3".q2 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$')) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND CASE WHEN "q".q2 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$' THEN SPLIT_PART("q".q2, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q".q2, ':', 2)::NUMERIC < 100 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref, COALESCE(SUM("t".points), 0) AS "total_points" FROM "drivers" AS "d" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "r".driverid, "r".points FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT raceid, driverid FROM "laptimes") AS "l" ON "l".raceid = "r".raceid AND "l".driverid = "r".driverid) AS "t" ON "t".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".forename = 'Robert' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".driverref LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".date, "d".forename, "d".surname, "f".time AS "fastest_lap_time" FROM "races" AS "r" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "l".raceid, "l".driverid, MIN("l".time) AS "time" FROM "laptimes" AS "l" INNER JOIN (SELECT raceid, driverid, MIN(milliseconds) AS "fastest_ms" FROM "laptimes" WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY raceid, driverid HAVING MIN(milliseconds) > 90000) AS "m" ON "m".raceid = "l".raceid AND "m".driverid = "l".driverid AND "m".fastest_ms = "l".milliseconds GROUP BY "l".raceid, "l".driverid) AS "f" ON "f".raceid = "r".raceid LEFT JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "f".driverid WHERE "r".name = 'French Grand Prix' AND "r".year >= 1990 ORDER BY "r".date ASC, "d".surname ASC, "d".forename ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".forename, "d".surname, "q".q3 FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "qualifying" AS "q" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$' AND (split_part("q".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) = (SELECT MIN(split_part("q2".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q2".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d2" ON "d2".driverid = "q2".driverid WHERE "d2".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q2".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver_name", "r".name AS "race_name", "r".year AS "race_year", "q".q3 AS "q3_time" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "d".nationality = 'British' AND "d".dob >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "q".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$' AND (SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) = (SELECT MIN(SPLIT_PART("q2".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q2".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d2" ON "d2".driverid = "q2".driverid WHERE "d2".nationality = 'British' AND "d2".dob >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "q2".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$') LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "d".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1976-01-01' AND "r".rank = 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+[.][0-9]+$' AND (split_part("q".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) = (SELECT MIN(split_part("q2".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q2".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+[.][0-9]+$') LIMIT 501

SELECT name, career_points, url FROM (SELECT "c".name, "c".url, COALESCE(SUM("s".points), 0) AS "career_points", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM("s".points), 0) DESC) AS "points_rank" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "cs".constructorid, "cs".points, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "cs".constructorid, "r".year ORDER BY "r".round DESC, "r".raceid DESC) AS "season_order" FROM "constructorstandings" AS "cs" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "cs".raceid) AS "s" ON "s".constructorid = "c".constructorid AND "s".season_order = 1 WHERE "c".nationality = 'Italian' GROUP BY "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url) AS "ranked" WHERE points_rank <= 3 ORDER BY points_rank ASC, name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, COUNT(DISTINCT "r".driverid) AS "winning_drivers" FROM "drivers" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid AND "r".position = 1 WHERE "d".forename IN ('Peter', 'John') GROUP BY "d".forename ORDER BY CASE "d".forename WHEN 'Peter' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE CASE WHEN "q".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN split_part("q".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC END = (SELECT MIN(CASE WHEN "q2".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN split_part("q2".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q2".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC END) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2") LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT "r".constructorid) AS "constructor_count" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".constructorid = "c".constructorid AND "r".rank = 1 GROUP BY "c".nationality ORDER BY "c".nationality ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, COUNT("p".stop) AS "total_pit_stops" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "ds".raceid FROM "driverstandings" AS "ds" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "ds".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Australian' AND "ds".position BETWEEN 1 AND 19) AS "qualifying_races" ON "qualifying_races".raceid = "r".raceid LEFT JOIN "pitstops" AS "p" ON "p".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013 GROUP BY "r".year ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q".driverid) AS "number_of_drivers" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".date >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND "r".date < DATE '1996-01-01' AND CASE WHEN "q".q1 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$' THEN split_part("q".q1, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC > 120 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver_name", "p".duration AS "pit_stop_time", "r".name AS "race_name", "c".name AS "circuit_name", "c".location AS "circuit_location" FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "p".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "p".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".date >= DATE '2016-09-01' AND "r".date < DATE '2016-10-01' AND "p".milliseconds = (SELECT MIN("p2".milliseconds) FROM "pitstops" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "p2".raceid WHERE "r2".date >= DATE '2016-09-01' AND "r2".date < DATE '2016-10-01') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "full_name", "d".nationality, "first_win".name AS "race_name", "first_win".date AS "race_date", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "results" AS "starts" INNER JOIN "races" AS "sr" ON "sr".raceid = "starts".raceid WHERE "starts".driverid = "d".driverid AND "sr".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017) AS "races_started" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "win" ON "win".driverid = "d".driverid AND "win".position = 1 INNER JOIN "races" AS "first_win" ON "first_win".raceid = "win".raceid AND "first_win".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017 ORDER BY "d".dob ASC NULLS LAST, ("d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname) ASC, "first_win".date ASC, "first_win".name ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".raceid) AS "runnings" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Accident' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "c".name AS "constructor_name" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "constructors" AS "c" ON "c".constructorid = "q".constructorid LEFT JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "q".raceid AND "res".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]{3}$' ORDER BY (split_part("q".q2, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q2, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) ASC, NULLIF("res".grid, 0) ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT "d".surname, "r".name FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "q".q2 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$' AND (split_part("q".q2, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q2, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) = (SELECT MIN(split_part("q2".q2, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q2".q2, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "q2".q2 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+[.][0-9]+$' AND CAST(split_part("q".q3, ':', 1) AS NUMERIC) * 60 + CAST(split_part("q".q3, ':', 2) AS NUMERIC) = (SELECT MIN(CAST(split_part("q2".q3, ':', 1) AS NUMERIC) * 60 + CAST(split_part("q2".q3, ':', 2) AS NUMERIC)) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "q".raceid AND "q2".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+[.][0-9]+$') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".code, "q".q3 AS "fastest_q3_time" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$' AND (split_part("q".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) = (SELECT MIN(split_part("q2".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q2".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "res".time AS "runner_up_time_gap" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid AND "res".position = 2 WHERE "r".raceid = (SELECT raceid FROM "races" WHERE name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 AND time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time ASC, year DESC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".code FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 <> 'NaN' ORDER BY "d".code ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "d".forename, "d".surname, "res".time FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017 AND "r".time::TIME <= TIME '17:00:00' AND "res".position = 1 ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number, "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "c".name = 'Autodromo Nazionale di Monza' AND "q".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]+$' AND split_part("q".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC < 98 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "early_circuit".circuitref AS "earliest_circuit_reference", "late_circuit".circuitref AS "latest_circuit_reference", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("latest".latest_time - "earliest".earliest_time)) AS "gap_seconds" FROM (SELECT MIN(time::TIME) AS "earliest_time" FROM "races" WHERE time IS NOT NULL) AS "earliest" INNER JOIN "races" AS "early_race" ON "early_race".time::TIME = "earliest".earliest_time INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "early_circuit" ON "early_circuit".circuitid = "early_race".circuitid CROSS JOIN (SELECT MAX(time::TIME) AS "latest_time" FROM "races" WHERE time IS NOT NULL) AS "latest" INNER JOIN "races" AS "late_race" ON "late_race".time::TIME = "latest".latest_time INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "late_circuit" ON "late_circuit".circuitid = "late_race".circuitid ORDER BY earliest_circuit_reference ASC, latest_circuit_reference ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "r".fastestlapspeed ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".dob ORDER BY MAX(CAST("r".fastestlapspeed AS NUMERIC)) DESC, "d".dob ASC, "d".surname ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND ("q".q2 IS NULL OR "q".q2 = '' OR "q".q2 = 'N/A') ORDER BY "q".q1 DESC NULLS LAST, "d".driverid ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "res".driverid) AS "drivers_withdrew" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "r".year = 1962 AND "r".name = 'British Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Withdrew' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "s".status = 'Finished' OR "s".status ~ '^[+][0-9]+ Laps?$' THEN "r".driverid END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "r".driverid), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "r".statusid WHERE "ra".year = 1957 AND "ra".name = 'British Grand Prix' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_total)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "mean_total_expense_per_event" FROM (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("e".cost::NUMERIC) AS "event_total" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Elijah' AND "m".last_name = 'Allen' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST("e".expense_date AS DATE)) IN (9, 10) GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "event_expenses" LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "ev".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "ev".event_date < '2020-01-01' THEN "b".spent ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "ev".event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND "ev".event_date < '2021-01-01' THEN "b".spent ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "difference" FROM "event" AS "ev" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "ev".event_id WHERE "ev".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "ev".event_date < '2021-01-01' LIMIT 501
SELECT notes FROM "income" WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received::DATE = DATE '2019-09-14' LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN "b".amount ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN "b".amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "ratio" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "b".link_to_event WHERE "b".category = 'Advertisement' AND "e".event_name IN ('Yearly Kickoff', 'October Meeting') LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name HAVING SUM("b".amount) <> 0 AND SUM("b".spent)::NUMERIC / SUM("b".amount) = (SELECT MAX("r".ratio) FROM (SELECT SUM("b2".spent)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM("b2".amount), 0) AS "ratio" FROM "event" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b2" ON "b2".link_to_event = "e2".event_id WHERE "e2".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e2".event_id) AS "r") LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) > 7 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, "m".phone FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "e".cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM "expense") LIMIT 501

SELECT "w".head_count AS "women_soccer_attendance", "f".average_attendance AS "fall_2019_average_attendance", CASE WHEN "w".head_count > "f".average_attendance THEN 'more' WHEN "w".head_count < "f".average_attendance THEN 'fewer' ELSE 'equal' END AS "verdict" FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "head_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_name = 'Women''s Soccer') AS "w" CROSS JOIN (SELECT ROUND(AVG("t".head_count), 1) AS "average_attendance" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "head_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date::DATE >= DATE '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date::DATE < DATE '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "t") AS "f" LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".department, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT "d".major_name, ', ' ORDER BY "d".major_name ASC) AS "majors_offered", STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "m".member_id IS NOT NULL THEN "d".major_name END, ', ' ORDER BY CASE WHEN "m".member_id IS NOT NULL THEN "d".major_name END ASC) AS "majors_held", ROUND(COUNT("m".member_id)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "d".major_id), 0), 2) AS "average_members_per_major" FROM "major" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".link_to_major = "d".major_id WHERE "d".department IN (SELECT "c".department FROM "major" AS "c" WHERE "c".college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences') GROUP BY "d".department ORDER BY "d".department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type AS "event_type", COALESCE(SUM("a".attendee_count), 0) AS "members_attended", COALESCE(SUM("b".budgeted_amount), 0) AS "total_budgeted" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS "budgeted_amount" FROM "budget" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY "e".type ORDER BY "e".type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "ma".department, COALESCE(SUM("i".amount), 0) AS "total_dues" FROM "major" AS "ma" LEFT JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".link_to_major = "ma".major_id AND "m".position = 'Member' AND "m".member_id IN (SELECT "a".link_to_member FROM "attendance" AS "a") LEFT JOIN "income" AS "i" ON "i".link_to_member = "m".member_id AND "i".source = 'Dues' WHERE "ma".college IN (SELECT college FROM "major" WHERE department = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering Department') GROUP BY "ma".department LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, ROUND(SUM("b".amount - COALESCE("b".spent, 0))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_amount_left" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member, link_to_budget FROM "expense" WHERE cost > 50) AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".budget_id = "e".link_to_budget GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name ORDER BY total_amount_left DESC, "m".last_name ASC, "m".first_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM("i".amount), 0) AS "total_dues" FROM "income" AS "i" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "a".link_to_member FROM "attendance" AS "a" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "a".link_to_event WHERE "e".event_name = 'Football game') AS "attendees" ON "attendees".link_to_member = "i".link_to_member WHERE "i".source = 'Dues' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "m".major_name) AS "major_count" FROM "major" AS "m" WHERE "m".college IN (SELECT "tm".college FROM "member" AS "t" INNER JOIN "major" AS "tm" ON "tm".major_id = "t".link_to_major WHERE "t".first_name = 'Tyler' AND "t".last_name = 'Hewitt') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "member" AS "enrolled" INNER JOIN "major" AS "em" ON "em".major_id = "enrolled".link_to_major WHERE "em".college = "m".college AND "em".major_name = "m".major_name) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("event_attendance".member_count), 2) AS "average_attendance" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id AND "b".category = 'Advertisement' LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_attendance" LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "number_of_members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".type = 'Budget' AND "e".event_date::DATE < DATE '2026-11-14' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".location ORDER BY "e".event_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".major_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "member" AS "mb" ON "mb".member_id = "a".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "m" ON "m".major_id = "mb".link_to_major WHERE "e".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "m".major_id, "m".major_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) = (SELECT MAX("t".attendee_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a2".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a2" ON "a2".link_to_event = "e2".event_id INNER JOIN "member" AS "mb2" ON "mb2".member_id = "a2".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "m2" ON "m2".major_id = "mb2".link_to_major WHERE "e2".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "m2".major_id, "m2".major_name) AS "t") ORDER BY "m".major_name ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "member" WHERE "member".link_to_major = "major".major_id)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "major" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_count) FILTER (WHERE position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer')), 2) AS "average_events_per_officer", ROUND(AVG(event_count) FILTER (WHERE position NOT IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') OR position IS NULL), 2) AS "average_events_per_other_student" FROM (SELECT "m".member_id, "m".position, COUNT(DISTINCT "e".event_id) AS "event_count" FROM "member" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id LEFT JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "a".link_to_event GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".position) AS "member_attendance" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LOWER(TRIM(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE("e".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), ',', "n".part)))) AS "count" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event FROM "budget" WHERE amount - spent < 0) AS "over_budget" ON "over_budget".link_to_event = "b".link_to_event CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 AS "part" UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS "part" UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS "part") AS "n" WHERE TRIM(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE("e".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), ',', "n".part)) <> '' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, ROUND(COALESCE("w".water_spent, 0)::NUMERIC / "a".attendees, 2) AS "water_spent_per_attendee" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS "attendees" FROM "attendance" WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("x".cost::NUMERIC) AS "water_spent" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE '%water%' GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "w" ON "w".link_to_event = "e".event_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "d".department IS NOT NULL) AS "majoring_in_college", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "d".department IS NULL) AS "not_majoring_in_college" FROM "member" AS "r" LEFT JOIN "major" AS "m" ON "m".major_id = "r".link_to_major LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT department FROM "major" WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' AND department IS NOT NULL) AS "d" ON "d".department = "m".department LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "b1".link_to_event FROM "budget" AS "b1" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b1".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE '%chips%' AND "x".cost > 0) AS "chip_events" ON "chip_events".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name HAVING MAX("b".amount) = (SELECT MAX("b2".amount) FROM "budget" AS "b2" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "b3".link_to_event FROM "budget" AS "b3" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x2" ON "x2".link_to_budget = "b3".budget_id WHERE "x2".expense_description ILIKE '%chips%' AND "x2".cost > 0) AS "chip_events2" ON "chip_events2".link_to_event = "b2".link_to_event) LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_date, SUM("e".cost::NUMERIC) AS "total_cost" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".position = 'Vice President' AND "e".expense_date = (SELECT MAX("e2".expense_date) FROM "expense" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m2" ON "e2".link_to_member = "m2".member_id WHERE "m2".position = 'Vice President') GROUP BY "e".expense_date ORDER BY "e".expense_date DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".location = 'MU 215' GROUP BY "e".type LIMIT 501

SELECT "ma".college, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_majors" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma" ON "m".link_to_major = "ma".major_id GROUP BY "ma".college HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "member" AS "m2" INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma2" ON "m2".link_to_major = "ma2".major_id GROUP BY "ma2".college ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY "ma".college ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "x".expense_description) AS "number_of_different_things_bought" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event FROM "budget" WHERE amount > 40) AS "q" ON "q".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id GROUP BY "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("b".amount) AS "total_budgeted" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "b".link_to_event INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "pb".link_to_event FROM "budget" AS "pb" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "pb".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description = 'Pizza') AS "pizza_events" ON "pizza_events".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-10-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_spent)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_spent_per_event" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COALESCE(SUM("b".spent), 0) AS "event_spent" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_totals" LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM(COALESCE("b".amount, 0)) AS "total_budget", SUM(COALESCE("b".spent, 0)) AS "total_spending" FROM "budget" AS "b" GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "totals" ON "totals".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM(CASE WHEN "x".expense_description IS NULL OR TRIM("x".expense_description) = '' THEN 0 ELSE LENGTH("x".expense_description) - LENGTH(REPLACE("x".expense_description, ',', '')) + 1 END) AS "purchases" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "counts" ON "counts".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' AND COALESCE("totals".total_spending, 0) <= COALESCE("totals".total_budget, 0) ORDER BY COALESCE("counts".purchases, 0) DESC, "e".event_id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "e".type, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "number_of_members" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date::DATE >= DATE '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date::DATE < DATE '2020-06-01' GROUP BY "e".type HAVING COUNT("a".link_to_member) = (SELECT COUNT("a2".link_to_member) FROM "event" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a2" ON "a2".link_to_event = "e2".event_id WHERE "e2".event_date::DATE >= DATE '2019-09-01' AND "e2".event_date::DATE < DATE '2020-06-01' GROUP BY "e2".type ORDER BY COUNT("a2".link_to_member) DESC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_description AS "item_name", COUNT(*) AS "record_count" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".category = 'Food' GROUP BY "e".expense_description ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".expense_description ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT TRIM(SPLIT_PART("x".expense_description, ',', "n".item_number)) AS "item_name", "b".category, SUM("x".cost::NUMERIC) AS "total_cost" FROM "expense" AS "x" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 AS "item_number" UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4) AS "n" WHERE "e".event_name = 'October Meeting' AND "x".approved = 'true' AND TRIM(SPLIT_PART("x".expense_description, ',', "n".item_number)) <> '' GROUP BY TRIM(SPLIT_PART("x".expense_description, ',', "n".item_number)), "b".category ORDER BY "b".category ASC, item_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".event_date, COALESCE("b".total_budgeted, 0) AS "total_amount_budgeted", COALESCE("a".member_count, 0) AS "number_of_members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS "total_budgeted" FROM "budget" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id ORDER BY "e".event_name ASC, "e".event_date ASC LIMIT 501
