SELECT INITCAP(LOWER(TRIM(item_name))) AS "item_name", COUNT(*) AS "times_bought" FROM (SELECT SPLIT_PART(REPLACE("e".expense_description, ' - ', ', '), ',', 1) AS "item_name" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".first_name ILIKE 'Sacha' AND "m".last_name ILIKE 'Harrison' UNION ALL SELECT SPLIT_PART(REPLACE("e".expense_description, ' - ', ', '), ',', 2) AS "item_name" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".first_name ILIKE 'Sacha' AND "m".last_name ILIKE 'Harrison' UNION ALL SELECT SPLIT_PART(REPLACE("e".expense_description, ' - ', ', '), ',', 3) AS "item_name" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".first_name ILIKE 'Sacha' AND "m".last_name ILIKE 'Harrison') AS "items" WHERE TRIM(item_name) <> '' AND LOWER(TRIM(item_name)) <> 'bakery' GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(item_name)) LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name || ' ' || "m".last_name AS "full_name", "k".kind_count, "s".total_spending FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN (SELECT "e".link_to_member, COUNT(DISTINCT LOWER(TRIM(SPLIT_PART("e".expense_description, ',', "n".n)))) AS "kind_count" FROM "expense" AS "e" CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 AS "n" UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4) AS "n" WHERE "e".expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND "e".expense_date < '2019-12-01' AND TRIM(SPLIT_PART("e".expense_description, ',', "n".n)) <> '' GROUP BY "e".link_to_member) AS "k" ON "k".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(cost::NUMERIC) AS "total_spending" FROM "expense" WHERE expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND expense_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY link_to_member) AS "s" ON "s".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "k".kind_count = (SELECT MAX("k2".kind_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LOWER(TRIM(SPLIT_PART("e2".expense_description, ',', "n2".n)))) AS "kind_count" FROM "expense" AS "e2" CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 AS "n" UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4) AS "n2" WHERE "e2".expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND "e2".expense_date < '2019-12-01' AND TRIM(SPLIT_PART("e2".expense_description, ',', "n2".n)) <> '' GROUP BY "e2".link_to_member) AS "k2") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "m".link_to_major) AS "number_of_majors" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "major" AS "j" ON "m".link_to_major = "j".major_id WHERE "j".department = 'Political Science Department' LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour, COUNT(*) AS "hero_count", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS "rank" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "c".colour IS NOT NULL AND "c".colour <> 'No Colour' GROUP BY "c".colour ORDER BY hero_count DESC, "c".colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "sp".power_name = 'Super Strength' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "neutral_percentage", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "neutral_marvel_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') THEN 'Marvel Comics' WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') THEN 'DC Comics' ELSE 'Tie' END AS "publisher", ABS(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics')) AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics') LIMIT 501
SELECT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190 AND "c".colour IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180 LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Strength') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND "s".full_name <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "p".publisher_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "h" ON "h".id = "s".hair_colour_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "sk" ON "sk".id = "s".skin_colour_id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "c".colour = "h".colour AND "c".colour = "sk".colour AND "c".colour NOT IN ('No Colour', '-', 'N/A', '') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".skin_colour_id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') THEN 'DC Comics' WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') THEN 'Marvel Comics' ELSE 'Tie' END AS "publisher", ABS(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')) AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics') LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".height_cm) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".height_cm > 0 AND "s".id IN (SELECT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" WHERE "hp".power_id NOT IN (SELECT "dc_hp".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "dc_hp" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "dc" ON "dc".id = "dc_hp".hero_id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dc_p" ON "dc_p".id = "dc".publisher_id WHERE "dc_p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "dc_hp".power_id IS NOT NULL)) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "power_count" FROM (SELECT "hp".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "strength_hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "strength_hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "strength" ON "strength".id = "strength_hp".power_id WHERE "strength".power_name = 'Super Strength') AS "strength_heroes" ON "strength_heroes".hero_id = "hp".hero_id GROUP BY "hp".power_id HAVING COUNT(*) = COUNT("strength_heroes".hero_id)) AS "qualifying_powers" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".skin_colour_id WHERE "c".colour = 'Green' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "a".alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad') OR "a".alignment IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT power_name, hero_count FROM (SELECT "sp".power_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) AS "hero_count", DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) DESC) AS "power_rank" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) NOT IN ('', '-') GROUP BY "sp".id, "sp".power_name) AS "ranked" WHERE power_rank = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "s".weight_kg > 0 AND "ha".attribute_value IN (SELECT "ha2".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" ON "ha2".hero_id = "s2".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "s2".superhero_name = 'Abomination' AND "a2".attribute_name = 'Intelligence') LIMIT 501

SELECT "g".gender, COUNT("s".id) AS "superhero_count" FROM "gender" AS "g" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "sh".id, "sh".gender_id FROM "superhero" AS "sh" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "sh".hair_colour_id WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue' AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" WHERE "hp".hero_id = "sh".id) >= 10) AS "s" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') GROUP BY "g".id, "g".gender ORDER BY "g".gender ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg))::BIGINT AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "s".weight_kg > 0 AND "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "ha".attribute_value IN (SELECT "hha".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "h" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "hha" ON "hha".hero_id = "h".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "h_attr" ON "h_attr".id = "hha".attribute_id WHERE "h".superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND "h_attr".attribute_name = 'Strength') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "superpower_count" FROM (SELECT id, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC NULLS LAST) AS "height_rank" FROM "superhero" WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL) AS "h" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "h".id WHERE "h".height_rank <= 10 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "character_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" WHERE "s".race_id IS NULL AND "s".publisher_id IN (SELECT publisher_id FROM "superhero" WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("power_counts".power_count), 2) AS "average_superpowers" FROM (SELECT "s".id, COUNT("hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "r".race = 'God / Eternal' AND "g".gender = 'Male' GROUP BY "s".id) AS "power_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("portfolio".power_count), 1) AS "average_superpowers" FROM (SELECT "hp".hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "shared".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "shared" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "cryo_hero_power" ON "cryo_hero_power".power_id = "shared".power_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "cryo" ON "cryo".hero_id = "cryo_hero_power".hero_id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "cryo".power_id WHERE "sp".power_name = 'Cryokinesis') AS "matching_heroes" ON "matching_heroes".hero_id = "hp".hero_id GROUP BY "hp".hero_id) AS "portfolio" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("dc".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "dc" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dp" ON "dp".id = "dc".publisher_id WHERE "dp".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "dc".weight_kg > 0 AND "dc".eye_colour_id IN (SELECT "marvel".eye_colour_id FROM "superhero" AS "marvel" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "mp" ON "mp".id = "marvel".publisher_id WHERE "mp".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("h".height_cm), 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "h" WHERE "h".race_id IN (SELECT "a".race_id FROM "superhero" AS "a" WHERE "a".superhero_name = 'A-Bomb') AND "h".height_cm > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".weight_kg) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" WHERE "s".race_id IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "superhero" AS "f" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "f".gender_id WHERE "f".race_id = "s".race_id AND "g".gender = 'Female') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "publisher_count" FROM "publisher" AS "p" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "s".height_cm > 200 AND "p".publisher_name IS NOT NULL AND "p".publisher_name NOT IN ('N/A', '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "p".publisher_name <> 'DC Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 1) AS "average_weight_kg", COUNT("s".weight_kg) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "h".id) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "h" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "b" ON "h".publisher_id = "b".publisher_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "other" ON "other".eye_colour_id = "h".eye_colour_id AND "other".publisher_id <> "h".publisher_id WHERE "b".superhero_name = 'Blackwulf' LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".race, COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id WHERE "s".publisher_id IN (SELECT publisher_id FROM "superhero" WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AND "r".race IS NOT NULL AND "r".race <> '-' GROUP BY "r".id, "r".race HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(race_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "race_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r2" ON "r2".id = "s2".race_id WHERE "s2".publisher_id IN (SELECT publisher_id FROM "superhero" WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AND "r2".race IS NOT NULL AND "r2".race <> '-' GROUP BY "r2".id) AS "counts") LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "s".weight_kg > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("ha".attribute_value), 1) AS "average_intelligence" FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "sp".power_name IN ('Super Speed', 'Death Touch')) AS "heroes" ON "heroes".hero_id = "ha".hero_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "ha".attribute_value IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "g".gender = 'Male' THEN COALESCE("p".power_count, 0) END), 2) AS "male_average", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "g".gender = 'Female' THEN COALESCE("p".power_count, 0) END), 2) AS "female_average" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "hero_power" GROUP BY hero_id) AS "p" ON "p".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) ~ '^[[:alpha:]][[:alpha:]''.-]*([[:space:]]+[[:alpha:]][[:alpha:]''.-]*)+$' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(NULLIF("s".height_cm, 0)) FILTER (WHERE "s".height_cm > 0), 2) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG(NULLIF("s".weight_kg, 0)) FILTER (WHERE "s".weight_kg > 0), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".skin_colour_id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "c".colour = 'Green' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "s".height_cm > 0 THEN "s".height_cm END), 1) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN "s".weight_kg > 0 THEN "s".weight_kg END), 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("h".height_cm), 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "s".id, "s".height_cm FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "target_hp" ON "target_hp".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "target" ON "target".id = "target_hp".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man' AND "s".id <> "target".id AND "s".height_cm > 0) AS "h" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".skin_colour_id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "p" ON "p".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".power_name = 'Flight') AS "f" ON "f".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "c".colour = 'Green' AND "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "s".weight_kg > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT hero_id FROM "hero_power") AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "superpower_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Male' AND "s".weight_kg < 70 AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".hair_colour_id WHERE "r".race = 'Human' AND "s".height_cm > 0 ORDER BY "s".height_cm ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT MAX(power_count) AS "largest_number_of_superpowers" FROM (SELECT "s".id, COUNT(DISTINCT "sp".power_name) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id LEFT JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "s".weight_kg = (SELECT MIN(weight_kg) FROM "superhero" WHERE weight_kg > 0) GROUP BY "s".id) AS "hero_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Speed' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Speed') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "eye".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "hair".colour <> 'Brown') AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "eye" ON "eye".id = "s".eye_colour_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "hair" ON "hair".id = "s".hair_colour_id GROUP BY "eye".id, "eye".colour HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "hair".colour = 'Brown') > 0 ORDER BY hero_count DESC, "eye".colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good') / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" WHERE "s".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".id IN (SELECT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "target_hp" ON "target_hp".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "target" ON "target".id = "target_hp".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'No Colour') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue') AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' AND "l".ua > 8.0 THEN "p".id END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".ua > 6.5 THEN "p".id END), 0) AS "male_to_female_ratio" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".alb)::NUMERIC, 4) AS "average_alb" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".plt > 400 AND "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".tg >= 200 AND "p".birthday < DATE '1976-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".glu >= 180 AND "l"."T-CHO" < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".hct >= 52) >= 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 2) AS "female_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday < DATE '1971-10-09' AND "l".pt >= 14 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".crp LIKE '%+%' AND "p".description IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".admission = '+') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory") AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1930-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1941-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT "l"."T-BIL", "l"."date", "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN rnp <> 'negative' THEN rnp::INTEGER END)::TEXT FROM "laboratory") AND "l"."T-BIL" = (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN rnp <> 'negative' THEN rnp::INTEGER END)::TEXT FROM "laboratory")) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1960-01-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) > 10 ELSE FALSE END) LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "l".id, "l".rnp AS "anti-RNP titer" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0')) AS "s" ON "s".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST("l".rnp AS BIGINT) = (SELECT MAX(CAST("r".rnp AS BIGINT)) FROM "laboratory" AS "r" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "q" ON "q".id = "r".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0')) AS "t" ON "t".id = "r".id WHERE "q".admission = '-' AND "r".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$') ORDER BY "l".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "platelets" ON "platelets".id = "p".id AND "platelets".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "antibodies" ON "antibodies".id = "p".id AND CASE WHEN "antibodies".rnp IN ('0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') THEN CAST("antibodies".rnp AS INTEGER) > 5 ELSE FALSE END WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'MCTD' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("l".test_dates, 0))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_laboratory_test_dates" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS "test_dates" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".dna FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' AND CAST("l".dna AS NUMERIC) = (SELECT MAX(CAST("l2".dna AS NUMERIC)) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "l2".id WHERE "p2".sex = 'F' AND "p2".admission = '+' AND "l2".dna ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$') ORDER BY "l".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l".rnp IN ('64', '256') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "h" ON "h".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id WHERE ("h".hct <= 29 OR "h".hct >= 52) AND "r".rnp IN ('64', '256') LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(CAST(rnp AS NUMERIC)) AS "highest_anti_rnp" FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "normal".id IS NOT NULL) AS "had normal platelet result", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "normal".id IS NULL) AS "never had normal platelet result" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE plt > 100 AND plt < 400) AS "normal" ON "normal".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ~* '^[[:space:]]*(RA[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*SJS|SJS[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*RA)[[:space:]]*$' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".tp::NUMERIC - 8.5), 3) AS "average_deviation" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "examination" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%') AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".tp > 8.5 LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE birthday >= DATE '1960-01-01') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE 'Psoriatic arthritis' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".alb < 3.5 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE elevated) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM (SELECT "p".id, BOOL_OR(CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 64 ELSE FALSE END) AS "elevated" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND ("l".rnp = 'negative' OR "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$') GROUP BY "p".id) AS "tested" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(1999 - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) AS "women", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN "p".id END) AS "men" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 32 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l"."date") - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p"."birthday")) AS "youngest_age" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) >= 64 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT("l".id) AS "total_laboratory_tests", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NULL) AS "patients_without_laboratory_tests" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE 'Psoriatic arthritis' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "id") AS "patient_count" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1998-01-01' AND "thrombosis" > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".thrombosis = 1 AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e".symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".symptoms ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' THEN id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "examination" WHERE thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(first_examination - "First Date")) AS "average_delay_days" FROM (SELECT "p".id, "p"."First Date", MIN("e"."Examination Date") AS "first_examination" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission LIKE '%+%' GROUP BY "p".id, "p"."First Date") AS "patient_examinations" LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "l".date >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1995-01-01' AND "l".got < 60 GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id AS "patient ID", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".ldh > 600 AND "l".ldh < 800 AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN "p".id END) AS "difference" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'RA' AND "l"."un" < 30 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patients_with_high_creatinine", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "total_patients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) / COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cre >= 1.5 WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".admission, "l".id, "l"."T-CHO" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("l2"."T-CHO") FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".admission = "p".admission) ORDER BY "p".admission ASC, "l".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "l".id, CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) AS "anti-RNP level" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) = (SELECT MAX(CAST("l2".rnp AS INTEGER)) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "l2".id WHERE "p2"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p2"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l2".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$') LIMIT 501
SELECT AVG("hct") AS "average hematocrit" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') AND "hct" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".admission IN ('+', '+(') THEN "p".id END) AS "admitted", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '-' THEN "p".id END) AS "outpatient" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'SLE' AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '+1(30)', '+2(100)', '>=300', '>=1000') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id AND "l".rf IN ('-', '+-') LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id AND ("e".kct = '+' OR "e".rvvt = '+' OR "e".lac = '+') WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "e".id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE (SELECT MAX("l".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id) > DATE '1997-01-01' AND (SELECT "l".sc170 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".sc170 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".date DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "a" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "p" ON "p".id = "a".id WHERE "a".ssa IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(TRIM("a".ssa)) NOT IN ('negative', '0') AND "p"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(TRIM("p"."U-PRO")) NOT IN ('negative', 'none', '-', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND CASE WHEN "l".dna ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST("l".dna AS NUMERIC) < 8 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission <> '-' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".alp >= 300) LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(rnp AS BIGINT) END) AS "highest_anti_rnp" FROM "laboratory" WHERE cre < 1.5 LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE "p".sex WHEN 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN 'M' THEN 'male' END AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "l".hgb < 7.0 GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY sex ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT id, date, rnp FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60 AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::NUMERIC = (SELECT MAX(rnp::NUMERIC) FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60 AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "eligibility_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1980-01-01' AND ("l".fg < 150 OR "l".fg > 450 OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "patient_group", COUNT("l".ldh) AS "measurement_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id AND "l".ldh < 500 WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patients_with_laboratory_results", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".elevated = 1) AS "patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MAX(CASE WHEN "T-BIL" >= 2.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "elevated" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IS NULL OR "p".sex = '' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission LIKE '+%' AND "p".birthday >= DATE '1945-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "e"."ANA Pattern" = 'P' LIMIT 501

SELECT "q".id, "q".sex, "q".highest_anti_rnp FROM (SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp IN ('0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') THEN CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) END) AS "highest_anti_rnp", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp IN ('0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') THEN CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) END) DESC NULLS LAST) AS "ranking" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex HAVING MIN("l".hgb) < 10 AND MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp IN ('0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') THEN CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) END) IS NOT NULL) AS "q" WHERE "q".ranking = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".date = (SELECT MIN("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "l".id) AND "l".got < 60 AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 10 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "l".date, "l"."U-PRO" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l".date = (SELECT MAX("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "l".id AND "l2"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".cpk < 250 AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp = 'negative' THEN 0 WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) ELSE NULL END > 4 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id WHERE "e".thrombosis = 0 AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) > 0 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('16', '64', '256')) AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id WHERE "l".gpt < 60 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".birthday ORDER BY MAX("l".gpt) DESC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".pt < 14 AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) >= 16 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE("l".date, "p".birthday)) AS "age", "p".diagnosis FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' ORDER BY CAST("l".dna AS NUMERIC) DESC, "l".date ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SLE([^[:alnum:]_]|$)' AND "p".diagnosis !~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SLE[[:space:]]+susp([.]|[^[:alnum:]_]|$)' AND "l"."T-BIL" >= 1.2 ORDER BY "p".sex ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care setting", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".id IS NOT NULL THEN "p".id END) AS "patients with at least one anti-RNP result of at least 4", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".id IS NULL THEN "p".id END) AS "patients with no such result" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id AND "l".rnp IN ('4', '15', '16', '64', '256') WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday <= DATE '1976-10-09' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "care setting" ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND (SELECT "l".igg FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".igg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".date DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) >= 2000 LIMIT 501

SELECT id, diagnosis, dna AS "highest_anti_dna_result" FROM (SELECT "p".id, "p".diagnosis, "l".dna, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "l".dna::NUMERIC DESC) AS "result_rank" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l".dna ~ '^[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)$') AS "ranked" WHERE result_rank = 1 GROUP BY id, diagnosis, dna ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (SELECT "l".igg FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".igg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".date DESC NULLS LAST, "l".igg DESC LIMIT 1) > 900 AND (SELECT "l".igg FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".igg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".date DESC NULLS LAST, "l".igg DESC LIMIT 1) < 2000) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M')) AS "difference" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".date = (SELECT MAX("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "p".id) AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp IN ('64', '256') THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".rnp = '256' AND "l".cpk < 250 AND "l".date IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "later" WHERE "later".id = "l".id AND "later".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "later".date > "l".date) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '+') AS "inpatients", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '-') AS "outpatients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '+') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission IN ('+', '-')), 0), 2) AS "inpatient_percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SLE([^[:alnum:]_]|$)' AND diagnosis !~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SLE[[:space:]]+susp' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l1" ON "p".id = "l1".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "p".id = "l2".id WHERE "l1".ldh >= 500 AND "l2"."U-PRO" IN ('100', '300', '+2(100)', '>=300', '>=1000') ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "number of female patients" FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND admission LIKE '+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e"."symptoms", "p"."diagnosis" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e"."id" = "p"."id" WHERE "e"."diagnosis" ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])SLE([^[:alnum:]]|$)' AND "e"."diagnosis" !~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])SLE[[:space:]]+susp([^[:alnum:]]|$)' AND "e"."symptoms" IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("e"."symptoms") <> '' AND "p"."birthday" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "p"."birthday" DESC, "p"."id" ASC, "e"."Examination Date" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT "diagnosis" FROM "patient" WHERE "First Date" >= DATE '1998-02-15' AND "First Date" < DATE '1998-03-01' AND "admission" IN ('+', '+(') AND "birthday" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY AGE("First Date", "birthday") DESC, "id" ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average anti-cardiolipin IgM" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1993-11-01' AND diagnosis = 'SLE' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "male_patients", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') AS "female_patients" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".gpt >= 60) LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count", ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 1) AS "average_completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rbc < 3.5) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average anti-cardiolipin IgM" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SJS([^[:alnum:]_]|$)' AND "p".diagnosis !~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SJS[[:space:]]+susp([^[:alnum:]_]|$)' AND "e"."aCL IgM" <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis ~* '(^|,)[[:space:]]*SjS[[:space:]]*(,|$)' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "s" ON "s".id = "e".id AND "s".sm IN ('negative', '0') INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id AND "p"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '+1(30)', '+2(100)', '>=1000', '>=300') LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "x" ON "x".id = "e".id AND "x".thrombosis <> 0 WHERE "e".thrombosis = 0 AND "x".id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' GROUP BY "p".id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN "l".rbc <= 3.5 OR "l".rbc >= 6.0 THEN 1 END) > 0 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN "l".rnp IN ('1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') THEN 1 END) > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 1) AS "average_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('64', '256')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday) < INTERVAL '70 years' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".wbc > 3.5 AND "l".wbc < 9.0 AND ("l".fg <= 150 OR "l".fg >= 450) AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp IN ('0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') THEN "l".rnp::INTEGER > 15 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M')), 0), 1) AS "women_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1936-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1957-01-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cpk >= 250) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1987-01-01' AND "l".date >= "p".birthday AND "l".date < "p".birthday + INTERVAL '50 years' AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS "average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT("a".atom_id) AS "oxygen_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '-') AS "single_bond_molecules" ON "single_bond_molecules".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'o' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_oxygen_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS "average_single_bonds_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "single_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(*) AS "atom_occurrences" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "m2".molecule_id = "a2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '-' GROUP BY "a2".element ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'i' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "iodine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 's' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "sulfur_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id WHERE "a".element IN ('i', 's') AND "b".bond_type = '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'f')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "b".bond_type ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id, "b".bond_type FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE ("a1".element = 'p' AND "a2".element = 'n') OR ("a1".element = 'n' AND "a2".element = 'p') LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" WHERE "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '#') AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "atom" WHERE element IN ('p', 'br')) AS "x" ON "x".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "percentage" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '-') AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'h')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "fraction", "m".label FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "b".bond_type <> '-') THEN 'every bond is a single bond' ELSE 'all other molecules' END AS "molecule_group", SUM(CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 1 WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN -1 ELSE 0 END) AS "carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic" FROM "molecule" AS "m" GROUP BY CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "b".bond_type <> '-') THEN 'every bond is a single bond' ELSE 'all other molecules' END ORDER BY CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "b".bond_type <> '-') THEN 'every bond is a single bond' ELSE 'all other molecules' END DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "carbon_carbon_double_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '=' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "atom" AS "all_atoms" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "all_molecules" ON "all_molecules".molecule_id = "all_atoms".molecule_id WHERE "all_molecules".label = '+'), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT atom_id FROM (SELECT atom_id FROM "connected" UNION ALL SELECT atom_id2 AS "atom_id" FROM "connected") AS "endpoints" GROUP BY atom_id) AS "bonded" ON "bonded".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "m2".molecule_id = "a2".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT atom_id FROM (SELECT atom_id FROM "connected" UNION ALL SELECT atom_id2 AS "atom_id" FROM "connected") AS "endpoints2" GROUP BY atom_id) AS "bonded2" ON "bonded2".atom_id = "a2".atom_id WHERE "m2".label = '+' GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic", COUNT("b".bond_id) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') WHERE "a".atom_id = 'TR041_10' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' THEN "b".bond_id END) AS "count" FROM "bond" AS "b" LEFT JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=', '#') GROUP BY "b".bond_type ORDER BY CASE "b".bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 1 WHEN '=' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "chlorine" ON "chlorine".atom_id = "c".atom_id WHERE "chlorine".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) AS "atom_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "s" ON "s".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "s".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "s".element = 's' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT MIN(molecule_id) AS "molecule_id" FROM "atom" GROUP BY element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1) AS "unique_elements" ON "unique_elements".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' GROUP BY "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') WHERE "a".element = 'n' AND "a".molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT "a2".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c2" ON "c2".atom_id = "a2".atom_id OR "c2".atom_id2 = "a2".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b2" ON "b2".bond_id = "c2".bond_id WHERE "a2".element = 'n' AND "b2".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id WHERE "a".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id) FILTER (WHERE "m".label = '+') / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id), 0), 2) AS "carcinogenic_percent", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id) FILTER (WHERE "m".label = '-') / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id), 0), 2) AS "non_carcinogenic_percent" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "other" WHERE "other".element = "a".element AND "other".molecule_id <> "a".molecule_id) GROUP BY "m".molecule_id ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("b".carbon_touching_bonds, 0) DESC, "a".atom_count DESC, "m".molecule_id ASC) AS "rank", "m".molecule_id, "m".label, "a".atom_count, COALESCE("b".bond_count, 0) AS "bond_count", "a".carbon_count, "a".chlorine_count, COALESCE("b".carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS "carbon_touching_bonds", COALESCE("b".multiple_bonds, 0) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count", SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "carbon_count", SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "chlorine_count" FROM "atom" GROUP BY molecule_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0) AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "bo".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "bond_count", SUM(CASE WHEN "cb".bond_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "carbon_touching_bonds", SUM(CASE WHEN "bo".bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "bond" AS "bo" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "c".bond_id FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id WHERE "a2".element = 'c') AS "cb" ON "cb".bond_id = "bo".bond_id GROUP BY "bo".molecule_id) AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id ORDER BY COALESCE("b".carbon_touching_bonds, 0) DESC, "a".atom_count DESC, "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "h" ON "h".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "y" ON "y".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "h".element = 'h' AND "y".element = 'y' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("degree".bond_count), 2) AS "average_bonds" FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".atom_id) AS "degree" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a2".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') AND "a1".element = 'c' GROUP BY "a2".element LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count", COUNT(DISTINCT (LEAST("a1".element, "a2".element), GREATEST("a1".element, "a2".element))) AS "element_pair_count", "m".label FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR377' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY bond_count DESC, "b".bond_type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a".element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb', 'mg', 'li') AND "b".bond_type = '-' ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "a".element, COUNT("saturated".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "c".atom_id FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id GROUP BY "c".atom_id HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type = '-') > 0 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) = 0) AS "saturated" ON "saturated".atom_id = "a".atom_id GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "triple_atom".element FROM "atom" AS "triple_atom" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "triple_atom".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#') AS "triple_elements" ON "triple_elements".element = "a".element GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "c".bond_id IS NOT NULL THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "bonded_atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501
